title: davallia villosa
intro: Davallia villosa, commonly known as the 'hairy davallia' or 'tongue fern', is a species of fern that belongs to the family Davalliaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various parts of the world for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Davallia villosa include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
